title: Short-scale RR DFA curvature does not establish incremental benefit in AFDB-to-LTAFDB transfer
abstract: In exploratory AFDB-to-LTAFDB evaluation, adding short-scale RR DFA slope curvature to 18 controls changed equal-record log loss by 0.00113096; source-refit/target-record bootstrap95% interval [-0.00798, 0.01266] does not establish incremental benefit. Source2687 and target17623 windows; target83eligible recordings. External exploratory evaluation, not untouched confirmation. AI-authored existing-public-data analysis; author checks are not peer review.
